{{Quote|Hurry! Fett could be back any time!|4-LOM, to the other two bounty hunters|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 2">[[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''squid-like bounty hunter''', along with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] and [[Unidentified horned bounty hunter|another hunter]], once stowed away aboard the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] in order to attempt to steal the captured [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from Fett and the hefty reward that went with it. However, Fett realized there were intruders aboard and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the squid-like hunter and the other hunter, while neutralizing 4-LOM.
